scene_breakdown.description: Woman in bed, looking directly at the camera, expressing discomfort.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: THE ITCHING GOT SO BAD I WAS BLEEDING

scene_breakdown.description: Woman continues to speak, explaining the nature of the bleeding.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: AND NOT MY PERIOD. I'D SCRATCHED MYSELF RAW IN MY SLEEP AND DIDN'T EVEN KNOW I WAS DOING

scene_breakdown.description: Woman describes the progression of the itch over time.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: SO THE ITCH STARTED MAYBE A YEAR AGO AND AT FIRST IT WAS JUST AFTER MY PERIOD, THEN IT WAS AFTER SEX, THEN IT WAS JUST CONSTANT

scene_breakdown.description: Woman explains the deep, internal nature of the itch.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: AND IT WASN'T A SURFACE ITCH. IT WAS DEEP LIKE INSIDE THE TISSUE WHERE NO AMOUNT OF SCRATCHING ACTUALLY HELPS

scene_breakdown.description: Woman recounts waking up scratching and finding blood.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: AND I'D WAKE UP CLAWING AT MYSELF HALF ASLEEP. EVEN SOME MORNINGS. THERE WAS BLOOD ON MY UNDERWEAR FROM SCRATCHING IN THE NIGHT, AND I DIDN'T EVEN REMEMBER DOING IT

scene_breakdown.description: Woman lists various failed treatments she tried.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: BUT I TRIED MONISTAT THINKING YEAST INFECTION, METRONIDAZOLE FROM THE DOC, THEN CLINDAMYCIN CREAM, AND EVERY TIME IT WOULD CALM DOWN FOR MAYBE A WEEK AND COME RIGHT BACK SOMETIMES WORSE

scene_breakdown.description: Woman describes the maddening sensation and social embarrassment of the itch.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: AND IT WASN'T EVEN THE ITCH ITSELF. IT WAS BEING SOMEWHERE YOU CAN'T SCRATCH. WORK MEETINGS, DINNER WITH FRIENDS, THE GYM. LIKE JUST SITTING THERE WITH THIS MADDENING SENSATION. AND YOU CAN'T DO ANYTHING ABOUT IT BECAUSE SCRATCHING DOWN THERE IN PUBLIC ISN'T EXACTLY AN OPTION

scene_breakdown.description: Woman introduces her research into why treatments failed.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: SO I STARTED RESEARCHING WHY NOTHING WAS WORKING AND WHY IT KEPT COMING BACK IN THE SAME SPOT

scene_breakdown.description: Microscopic view of green bacteria, overlaid on the woman's head.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: AND WHAT I FOUND IS THAT WHEN BAD BACTERIA OVERGROW

scene_breakdown.description: Microscopic view of bacteria forming a protective shield, overlaid on the woman's head.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: THEY BUILD THESE PROTECTIVE SHIELDS ON THE VAGINAL WALLS CALLED BIOFILMS

scene_breakdown.description: Microscopic view of bacteria producing toxins, overlaid on the woman's head.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: THE BACTERIA HIDDEN UNDERNEATH PRODUCE INFLAMMATORY TOXINS THAT IRRITATE THE TISSUE FROM THE INSIDE

scene_breakdown.description: Microscopic view of bacteria embedded in tissue, protected by a biofilm, overlaid on the woman's head.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: SO THE ITCH ISN'T ON THE SURFACE WHERE CREAMS CAN REACH. IT'S COMING FROM BACTERIA EMBEDDED IN THE TISSUE PROTECTED BY THIS BIOFILM LAYER

scene_breakdown.description: Woman explains why antibiotics and antifungals were ineffective.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: AND EVERY TIME ANTIBIOTICS OR ANTIFUNGALS KILL THE SURFACE BACTERIA, THE PROTECTED COLONY UNDERNEATH SURVIVES AND TRIGGERS THE INFLAMMATION AGAIN, WHICH IS WHY THE ITCH KEPT RETURNING TO THE EXACT SAME SPOT

scene_breakdown.description: Woman reiterates the ineffectiveness of topical treatments.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: SO CREAMS WERE NEVER GOING TO FIX IT BECAUSE THEY CAN'T BREAK THROUGH THE BIOFILM TO REACH WHAT'S ACTUALLY CAUSING THE IRRITATION

scene_breakdown.description: Woman explains the solution, with a screenshot of a scientific paper about Bromelain and pineapple stems overlaid.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: BUT APPARENTLY THE ONLY THING SHOWN TO DISSOLVE BIOFILMS IS AN ENZYME CALLED BROMELAIN FROM PINEAPPLE STEMS. AND NEW RESEARCH SHOWS IT BREAKS DOWN UP TO 98% OF BIOFILM STRUCTURE. SO THE BACTERIA HAVE NOWHERE TO HIDE

scene_breakdown.description: Woman explains the probiotic component, with a screenshot about Bacillus coagulans overlaid.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: AND I FOUND A FORMULA THAT COMBINED THE BROMELAIN WITH BACILLUS COAGULANS PROBIOTIC TO REBUILD HEALTHY BACTERIA ONCE THE BIOFILM CLEARS

scene_breakdown.description: Woman shares her positive results and timeline of improvement.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: AND STARTED TAKING TWO A DAY. BUT I KID YOU NOT, THE FIRST WEEK THE NIGHTTIME ITCH CALMED DOWN AND BY WEEK TWO, I WAS SLEEPING THROUGH THE NIGHT FOR THE FIRST TIME IN MONTHS

scene_breakdown.description: Woman concludes her testimonial, emphasizing long-term relief and the core problem.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: AND BY WEEK THREE, THE DEEP ITCH THAT HAD BEEN DRIVING ME CRAZY JUST WASN'T THERE ANYMORE. AND IT'S BEEN THREE MONTHS NOW. NO CREAMS, NO ANTIBIOTICS, AND NO WAKING UP AT 2 A.M. SCRATCHING MYSELF RAW. SO IF THERE'S AN ITCH THAT WON'T GO AWAY, NO MATTER WHAT GETS THROWN AT IT, IT'S PROBABLY NOT YEAST, IT'S PROBABLY BIOFILM. AND UNTIL THAT BREAKS, NOTHING TOPICAL IS GOING TO REACH IT

scene_breakdown.description: Woman smiles, holds up a gummy, eats it, and gives a thumbs up, then holds the product packaging.
scene_breakdown.text_on_screen: I GOT CALLED NUORA BELOW IF YOU WANT TO CHECK

visual_style.overall_aesthetic: Authentic, personal, and informative UGC with scientific overlays.
visual_style.color_palette: Warm, neutral bedroom tones with bright, contrasting text overlays and vibrant scientific imagery.
visual_style.text_overlay_style: Large, bold, white text with a blue/purple gradient outline, often accompanied by relevant emojis. Text appears dynamically with speech.

dr_elements.hook_text: The itching got so bad I was bleeding.
dr_elements.problem_agitation: The ad thoroughly agitates the problem by describing the severity (bleeding, scratching raw in sleep), persistence (constant, returning worse), deep nature of the itch (not surface), and social embarrassment/disruption (work, friends, gym).
dr_elements.mechanism_education: Educates on the concept of 'biofilms' formed by bad bacteria on vaginal walls, explaining how these shields protect bacteria from topical treatments and produce inflammatory toxins from the inside. Introduces Bromelain as an enzyme that dissolves biofilms and Bacillus coagulans as a probiotic to rebuild healthy bacteria.
belief_shifts: The itch isn't just a surface issue, it's deep within the tissue.
Traditional treatments (creams, antibiotics) fail because they can't penetrate protective 'biofilms'.
Biofilms are the root cause of recurring irritation and inflammation.
Bromelain is a natural enzyme that can break down these protective biofilms.
Bacillus coagulans probiotic helps restore healthy vaginal flora after biofilm removal.
There's a specific product (Nuora Below) that addresses this underlying mechanism.

viral_organic_elements.scroll_stopping_technique: Shocking and relatable personal problem statement in the hook, direct eye contact, and the use of emojis and dynamic text overlays.
viral_organic_elements.curiosity_gap: Why did all the conventional treatments fail? What is the *real* cause of this persistent itch?
viral_organic_elements.pattern_interrupt: The sudden insertion of scientific b-roll (bacteria, biofilms, research papers) breaks the monotony of the talking head and adds visual interest and credibility.
viral_organic_elements.storytelling_arc: Personal struggle (problem) -> Failed attempts (agitation) -> Research & discovery (mechanism) -> Successful solution (resolution) -> Recommendation (call to action).

broll_segments.description: Microscopic animation of green rod-shaped bacteria.
Animated diagram showing bacteria forming a protective layer (biofilm) on tissue.
Animated diagram showing bacteria within a biofilm irritating underlying tissue.
Microscopic image of a cell with bacteria embedded, illustrating the biofilm layer.
Screenshot of a scientific paper abstract mentioning Bromelain's effectiveness against biofilms.

key_takeaway: Combine a highly relatable, agitated personal problem with clear, scientifically-backed mechanism education (using visual aids) to explain why previous solutions failed and how the new solution works, culminating in a strong personal testimonial and direct product recommendation. The raw UGC feel with professional text overlays and b-roll enhances credibility and engagement.
